## Summary

**What it is:** A local Python CLI that builds a personalized study plan for Practical Nurse (PN) exam prep from your own tagged missed questions. It reads JSON seed files, generates study plans balanced across topics and client needs, and tracks progress locally—all without network or database.

**Rules anyone must follow:**
- Standard library only; keep it local with no network
- Store everything in plain JSON (no database); must be editable in phone text editor
- Never include actual paid qbank question text—only topic tags and personal notes
- All plan templates must reinforce PN scope of practice (reinforce, monitor, report, follow the care plan)
- Balance study days so no day has more than two topics from the same client need
- Keep 7 as the default; don't package or publish to GitHub—personal use only

**Still owed before sharing:**
- Someone with a nursing background must review every plan template for scope-of-practice wording before the owner shows this to a study group—this is a hard gate and hasn't happened yet.
